game_rules_players_2_4:
📚 *Game Rules* 📚

👥 *Players:* 2-4 people.
🃏 *Cards:* Each player starts with 5 cards.

🔄 *How to Play:*
A card is placed on the table to set the suit (❤️ ♦️ ♣️ ♠️).
On your turn, you can play 1-3 cards that match the suit.
If you have no matching cards, use the *Universal Card* 🎴.
After playing, the next player can either:
1️⃣ *Continue* - Accept the move and play their turn.
2️⃣ *Call LIAR!* - Challenge the played cards.

❗ *If LIAR is called:*
✔️ *Truth?* The challenger gets “shot.”
❌ *Lie?* You get “shot.”

🌟 *Special Cards:*
🎴 *Universal Card* - Matches any suit.
🃏 *Joker* - Play it alone. If someone challenges, *everyone else gets shot!*

⚙️ *Other Rules:*
🔹 If you run out of cards, you skip your turn.
🔹 The gun has 6 spots, but only 1 real bullet.

🏆 *Winning Condition:*
The last player left standing wins!
